001package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog;
002
003import org.apache.commons.lang3.Validate;
004import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.annotations.HistoryLogProps;
005import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.helpers.Bytes;
006import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.currentStatus.BolusPermissionChangeReasonResponse;
007
008/**
009 * Written when the pump's bolus permission for a bolus id changes hands. Tandem publishes no name
010 * for opcode 295 (it is absent from the Mobi app's HistoryLogType enum and from the Tandem Source
011 * schema), so this class name is provisional.
012 *
013 * <p>Every bolus writes two of these: one when permission is granted (byte 12 nonzero, byte 13 and
014 * the change reason 0) and one when it is released or revoked (byte 12 zero, byte 13 equal to the
015 * first record's byte 12, the change reason nonzero). This holds for BLE, pump-UI and Control-IQ
016 * boluses alike; see https://github.com/jwoglom/pumpX2/issues/142.
017 */
018
019/**
020 * History log record Bolus Permission Change, opCode 295, size 26.
021 *
022 * <br>
023 *
024 * Written when the pump's bolus permission for a bolus id changes hands. Tandem publishes no name
025 * for opcode 295 (it is absent from the Mobi app's HistoryLogType enum and from the Tandem Source
026 * schema), so this class name is provisional.
027 *
028 * <p>Every bolus writes two of these: one when permission is granted (byte 12 nonzero, byte 13 and
029 * the change reason 0) and one when it is released or revoked (byte 12 zero, byte 13 equal to the
030 * first record's byte 12, the change reason nonzero). This holds for BLE, pump-UI and Control-IQ
031 * boluses alike; see https://github.com/jwoglom/pumpX2/issues/142.
032 *
033 * 
034 * <table border='1'>
035 * <caption>Message properties:</caption>
036 * <tr><th>&nbsp;<code>opCode</code>&nbsp;</th><td>&nbsp;<code>295</code>&nbsp;</td></tr>
037 * <tr><th>&nbsp;<code>displayName</code>&nbsp;</th><td>&nbsp;<code>"Bolus Permission Change"</code>&nbsp;</td></tr>
038 * </table>
039 */@HistoryLogProps(
040    opCode = 295,
041    displayName = "Bolus Permission Change"
042)
043public class BolusPermissionChangeHistoryLog extends HistoryLog {
044
045    private int bolusId;
046    private int unknownU8At12;
047    private int unknownU8At13;
048    private int changeReasonId;
049
050    public BolusPermissionChangeHistoryLog() {}
051
052    public BolusPermissionChangeHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int bolusId, int unknownU8At12, int unknownU8At13, int changeReasonId) {
053        this(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, bolusId, unknownU8At12, unknownU8At13, changeReasonId, 0);
054    }
055
056    public BolusPermissionChangeHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int bolusId, int unknownU8At12, int unknownU8At13, int changeReasonId, int headerHighNibble) {
057        super(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum);
058        this.cargo = buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, bolusId, unknownU8At12, unknownU8At13, changeReasonId, headerHighNibble);
059        this.bolusId = bolusId;
060        this.unknownU8At12 = unknownU8At12;
061        this.unknownU8At13 = unknownU8At13;
062        this.changeReasonId = changeReasonId;
063    }
064
065    public int typeId() {
066        return 295;
067    }
068
069    /**
070     * <table border="1">
071     * <caption>Parsed fields for BolusPermissionChangeHistoryLog:</caption>
072     * <tr><td><code>bolusId</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 10)</code></td></tr>
073     * <tr><td><code>unknownU8At12</code></td><td><code>raw[12] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
074     * <tr><td><code>unknownU8At13</code></td><td><code>raw[13] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
075     * <tr><td><code>changeReasonId</code></td><td><code>raw[14] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
076     * </table>
077     */
078    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
079        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == 26);
080        this.cargo = raw;
081        parseBase(raw);
082        this.bolusId = Bytes.readShort(raw, 10);
083        this.unknownU8At12 = raw[12] & 0xFF;
084        this.unknownU8At13 = raw[13] & 0xFF;
085        this.changeReasonId = raw[14] & 0xFF;
086    }
087
088    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int bolusId, int unknownU8At12, int unknownU8At13, int changeReasonId, int headerHighNibble) {
089        return HistoryLog.fillCargo(Bytes.combine(
090            HistoryLog.typeIdBytes(295, headerHighNibble),
091            Bytes.toUint32(pumpTimeSec),
092            Bytes.toUint32(sequenceNum),
093            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(bolusId),
094            new byte[]{ (byte) unknownU8At12, (byte) unknownU8At13, (byte) changeReasonId }));
095    }
096
097    /**
098     * @return the bolus id the permission belongs to. It matched the BolusActivated, BolusDelivery
099     * and BolusCompleted ids of the same bolus in every record observed.
100     */
101    public int getBolusId() {
102        return bolusId;
103    }
104
105    /**
106     * @return byte 12. Meaning unconfirmed: it is 1, 2 or 3 on the grant record and 0 on the
107     * release record. Across the observed boluses the value tracked who asked for the bolus:
108     * 1 for a BLE app (BolusDelivery bolusSource 8), 2 for Control-IQ (bolusSource 7) and 3 for
109     * the pump's own UI (bolusSource 1 on t:slim X2, 0 for a Mobi button bolus).
110     */
111    public int getUnknownU8At12() {
112        return unknownU8At12;
113    }
114
115    /**
116     * @return byte 13. Meaning unconfirmed: 0 on the grant record; on the release record it equals
117     * byte 12 of the grant record for the same bolus id.
118     */
119    public int getUnknownU8At13() {
120        return unknownU8At13;
121    }
122
123    /**
124     * @return byte 14: 0 on the grant record, then the reason the permission ended. It equals
125     * {@link BolusPermissionChangeReasonResponse#getLastChangeReasonId()} for the same bolus id
126     * wherever both were captured (1 = released, 2 = revoked because the pump UI took priority).
127     */
128    public int getChangeReasonId() {
129        return changeReasonId;
130    }
131
132    public BolusPermissionChangeReasonResponse.ChangeReason getChangeReason() {
133        return BolusPermissionChangeReasonResponse.ChangeReason.fromId(changeReasonId);
134    }
135}
